title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Robert Half are recruiting for an Accounts Assistant on a temporary basis in the Swindon area for 6 months.

Office based 5 days per week.

The day-to-day responsibilities include filing, assisting with accounts administration, vehicles, tax and insurance administration, liaising with branches, compiling payroll information (rather than processing payroll), and general finance administration duties.

There are also several additional administrative tasks involved, such as uniform distribution, stationery ordering, fuel card administration, and other ad hoc duties as required.

Given that the role sits across both HR and Finance functions, this is quite a varied role.
- Managing incoming emails and acting as a key point of contact
- Handling inbound and outbound phone calls
- Issuing invoices, credits, and statements to customers in line with requests
- Accounts such as journals, fixed assets management
- Processing timesheets every Monday
- Chasing Business Managers for outstanding timesheets
- Monitoring and maintaining vehicle MOTs and road tax (fortnightly checks)
- Completing mileage and expense claims
- Maintaining compliance checklists
- Updating branch registers (e.g. key holders, utilities)
- Managing uniform orders and stock
- Processing Return to Work forms
- Maintaining employee records (electronic and hard copy filing)
- Supporting ONS (Office for National Statistics) requests (as required

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
Accounts Payable Assistant (Part-Time)

Location: Corsham
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per annum (Full-Time Equivalent)
Job Type: Part-time, Permanent
Working Hours: 25 hours per week - Monday - Friday (flexible on start and finish times) OR 3 full days per week

We are currently recruiting for a part-time Accounts Payable Assistant to join a growing and innovative business based in Corsham

The position is offered on a part-time basis, with flexibility around how the hours are worked. Whether you are looking for school-friendly hours across five days or prefer to work hours over 3 days.

As part of a smaller, growing business, a flexible and hands-on approach is important, with the opportunity to assist with wider office duties when required.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the accounts payable inbox and responding to relevant queries.
- Uploading, registering and coding supplier invoices onto the finance system.
- Processing invoices and matching them against purchase orders.
- Processing employee expenses and ensuring records are maintained accurately.
- Preparing weekly supplier payment runs for management approval.
- Processing one-off supplier payments as required.
- Raising purchase orders relating to intercompany recharges.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations and intercompany reconciliations.
- Carrying out bank reconciliations.
- Liaising with suppliers, contractors, consultants and internal colleagues to resolve queries.
- Providing general finance and administrative support as required.
- Providing support to other areas of the business during quieter periods e.g. assisting on reception if required
- Adopting a flexible, hands-on approach to supporting the wider team.

We are looking for someone with previous accounts payable and purchase ledger experience who takes pride in producing accurate work and keeping financial records organised.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Payable and Purchase Ledger - essential
- Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload effectively.
- Confident communication skills, particularly when dealing with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- The ability to work independently

Desirable:
- Experience using Xero accounting software.
- Familiarity with ApprovalMax.
- Knowledge of Airwallex payment systems.

CMD Recruitment acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment businesses for the supply of temporary workers.

title: Accounts Receivable
description:
Are you a fluent FRENCH OR ITALIAN Speaker or have a good understanding?

Do you have previous accounts receivable or credit control experience or transferable skills within a similar role?

Then this may be the job for you!

We are currently recruiting for a FRENCH OR ITALIAN speaking Accounts Credit Controller (Accounts Receivables) for a well-established client in the Swindon area.

Our Swindon based client is looking for a French or Italian speaking Credit Controller focusing on Accounts Receivables where you will be supporting the AR Ledgers for their Italian sites. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in managing collections and enjoys the challenge of setting up new customers and assessing credit risks.

Day-to-day of the role:
- In this role you will be supporting the Italian sites AR Ledger's
- Set up new customers and perform risk assessments on credit lines.
- Hold debtor aging meetings with local customer service teams, sales, and finance controllers to discuss customer status and provide necessary support.
- Report weekly debtor data, including bad debt actual and projected figures.
- Manage month-end close processes and complete reconciliations with Accounts Receivable and General Ledger.
- Perform weekly General Ledger uploads.
- Partner internally as part of the European Shared Service Centre with other functions to enhance business processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Fluency in French and Italian is essential.
- Proven experience in credit control or Accounts Receivable, managing multiple customer ledgers.
- An accounting qualification is preferred but not essential.
- Strong business partnering, customer service, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
- Good working knowledge of MS Excel
- Excellent communication abilities.
- Capability to multi-task and meet key month-end targets and timelines.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits programme.
- Flexible working hours and a generous holiday schedule of 28 days plus bank holidays.
- Private health insurance, dental insurance, pension plan, and life assurance.
- A supportive and inclusive work environment that values safety, quality, inclusion, and self-improvement.
- Opportunities for career growth in a global organisation that values autonomy and personal contribution.

This is an integral role for our client, and they are looking to interview people as soon as possible. If you are interested in this role and would like to hear more and potentially be submitted, please apply now and we can arrange a call.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Keen to join a company recognised and voted as a Great Place to Work and the Motor Trader s Employer of the Year ? We are looking for a Credit Controller to come in and become a vital part of our finance team, where your attention to detail and ability to build strong relationships will make a real impact.

As a company Credit Controller, you ll take ownership of customer accounts, ensuring cash flow remains strong and consistent across the business. You ll monitor aged debt, proactively engage with customers to secure payments, and resolve account queries with professionalism and confidence. From accurate cash allocation to account reconciliation, your work will directly support the financial health of the organisation.

Role - Credit Controller, Purchase Ledger, Collections Advisor, Credit Control, Debt collection, Collections Agent etc.

Location: Westbury, Wiltshire

Salary: £12.71 per hour (40 hours per week Mon to Fri 9am-5:30pm) working out to Roughly £26.4k per annum

We re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, stays organised under pressure, and takes pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work. You ll have previous experience in a Credit Control or Debt Recovery related role, be confident communicating with customers, capable of prioritising high-risk accounts, and comfortable working with financial data and Excel. Just as importantly, you ll collaborate with internal teams to resolve discrepancies and continuously look for ways to improve processes.

You will be joining a supportive and driven team that values professionalism, integrity, and continuous improvement. If you re ready to take the next step in your finance career and play a key role in keeping the business moving forward, we d love to hear from you.

CLICK APPLY and send through your CV today!

title: Credit Controller - Accounts Receivable
description:
Credit Controller - Accounts Receivable

Location: Westbury, Wiltshire

Salary: £26,436.80 annual equivalent, based on 40 hours per week

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm

Benefits: 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays, birthday leave, pension, enhanced family leave pay and wellbeing support

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

ISQ Recruitment is recruiting a Credit Controller for a well-established automotive business in Westbury. This is an opportunity to take ownership of customer accounts within a busy finance team, with weekday working hours, ongoing development and a comprehensive benefits package.

If you have experience in credit control, accounts receivable or sales ledger collections, this role offers the chance to put your skills to work managing overdue balances, resolving queries and building positive customer relationships.

The Role

You will support the business's cash flow by keeping customer accounts accurate and payments on track. Working closely with customers and internal departments, you will investigate discrepancies, prioritise overdue debt and help resolve issues that delay payment.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage customer accounts and review credit limits in accordance with company procedures.
- Monitor aged debt and follow up overdue invoices by telephone and email.
- Secure payments while maintaining professional customer relationships.
- Allocate incoming payments accurately and reconcile customer accounts.
- Investigate invoice disputes, payment differences and account queries.
- Work with internal teams to resolve billing discrepancies promptly.
- Identify higher-risk balances and maintain clear records of collection activity.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience managing customer accounts, aged debt and payment collections.
- A sound understanding of credit control and accounts receivable processes.
- Experience with cash allocation and account reconciliation.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident communication skills and a professional approach to payment discussions.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A discreet approach to confidential financial information.

What's on Offer
- 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with an increase after five years' service.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Company pension and death-in-service benefit of four times salary.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- Employee Assistance Programme, wellbeing support and access to a 24-hour online GP.
- Training, mentoring and opportunities for career development.
- Employee recognition and long-service rewards.

Appointment may be subject to a satisfactory DBS check. Please let ISQ Recruitment know if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process.

ISQ Recruitment Ltd is acting as an employment agency in relation to this vacancy.

description:

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk / Finance Administrator
description:
About the company

Our client is a modern, forward-thinking business based in Chippenham. They're growing, they invest in their people and systems, and they want a finance team that is efficient and also looking for better ways to work. This is a chance to join a supportive team where your ideas will be heard and your work will make a visible difference.

The role

As Purchase Ledger Clerk / Finance Administrator, you'll keep the purchase ledger accurate and up to date and support the wider finance function day to day. The work is varied and hands-on, so it would suit someone who likes structure and is happy to help wherever it's needed.

Key responsibilities
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes accurately and on time
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and resolving discrepancies
- Preparing and processing weekly or monthly supplier payment runs
- Reconciling supplier statements and dealing with supplier queries
- Maintaining supplier records and the purchase ledger
- Processing expense claims and company card transactions
- Supporting month-end tasks, including accruals and reconciliations
- General finance administration, filing and ad hoc support to the finance team

About you
- Previous experience in a purchase ledger, accounts payable or finance admin role
- Good working knowledge of accounting software (e.g. Xero, Sage, QuickBooks or similar)
- Confident with Excel
- Organised, accurate and good with detail
- A clear communicator, comfortable dealing with suppliers and colleagues
- Proactive and open to new systems and ways of working
- AAT studies (part or fully qualified) would be an advantage but aren't essential

What's on offer
- Salary of £30,000 - £40,000, depending on experience
- A modern, friendly working environment
- Opportunities to develop your skills and grow with the business
